purpose: Choose a viable on-demand revalidation executor before an execution admission is consumed, preferring a fresh credential-proven direct Railway path and otherwise selecting an explicitly proven native Git deployment path.

modes.readiness: Requires a fresh OIDC-recorded readiness receipt proving the Core GitHub Actions Railway credential is present.
Requires an explicit target executor profile with a previously verified GitHub-to-Railway deployment path.

approvalBoundary: The selected executor mode is recorded in the explicit approval.
If executor selection changes after approval, admission fails closed and requires re-approval.
A native_git selection does not consume an execution admission until a native Git candidate/trigger is prepared.
A direct_railway workflow checks credential presence before claiming the execution admission.
invariants: Credential values are never stored or returned; only boolean readiness and bounded evidence are recorded.
Readiness receipts expire and cannot be used indefinitely.
Native Git readiness must be backed by a previously verified exact-commit Railway deployment.
Selector state never changes raw health, release admission or estate state.
No selection result performs an external mutation.
Browser roles receive no table access or function EXECUTE grants.
